subject: S16 done: planner, rebalance, ICS, Web Push (a4ad26b)
body:
S16 landed on claude/naadi-shared as a4ad26b (3 commits on top of fb99501: planner feature, VAPID redaction / exam names / e2e SW isolation, e2e onboarding message).
CI run (queued behind the backlog when posted): https://github.com/arrowassassin/naadi/actions/runs/44027078060

BUILT
- plan/rebalance.py: pure function (assessment days + E-1 rest day never touched/received, order kept, capacity target x 1.25, review items dropped first then read/cards spill, unplaced = warning, deterministic). Property tests over generated plans of 21-180 days (60 seeds) + golden 3-missed-days case.
- planner graph (aegra.json): propose -> interrupt -> apply in one transaction on accept; stale plans expire the proposal; zero LLM calls. Coach nightly pass stores proposals; Today shows a violet strip + "Full plan" link.
- API: GET /api/plan/week (200 with {week:null} when no plan, so no 404 console error), PATCH /api/plan/items/{id} (LWW, tie -> server), POST /api/plan/items, POST /api/plan/rebalance (starts the planner run via loopback, returns thread), GET /api/plan/rebalances, calendar feed (hashed token, shown once, rotate/revoke, ICS rate limited, no PII), /api/push/{key,subscriptions,test}, daily reminder pass (system cron */15, planner graph mode reminders, <= push_max_per_day, 404/410 deletes).
- Migration 0027 (renumbered: 0022 was S15b; down_revision 0025): plan_rebalances, calendar_feeds, push_subscriptions + RLS, plan_items client = select + update(status, client_updated_at_ms) only.
- Web: /plan (iPad landscape 7-col grid; portrait/phone strip + day list), violet rebalance card with Show changes diff, item sheet with deep links, offline status queue ("Will sync"), Settings -> Study plan (feed + reminders with install steps / "not switched on yet" gate), sw.ts push handlers only (S18 marker), manifest + icons, vite-plugin-pwa 2.0.0 + workbox deps for S18.
- VAPID_* owner-provided: settings.py, docs/SECRETS.md, check_env.py, .env.example, push_space_secrets.sh; private key redacted in logs; never generated/committed. Push gated by "requires public Space/keys" state.

TESTS
- Gate (lint, typecheck, vitest 458+, pytest not live/not db 1304): green at integrate.
- db suite (fresh stack, seeded): 472 plan/rls/migration tests green after final rebase; earlier full db run 511 pass, 2 unrelated failures (S21 authoring answer-column scan in test_qbank_db; test_seed key count on my polluted local DB). tests/agent/test_planner_graph.py runs the real Aegra host (propose, interrupt, accept/decline, isolation).
- e2e smoke set (planner + today + shell) 2x --retries=0: 86 passed, 4 skipped, 0 failed on webkit-ipad-portrait, webkit-ipad-landscape, webkit-phone-390. chromium-laptop-1440 could NOT run locally (sandbox has chromium build 1243, Playwright wants 1255): CI judges it, incl. the Chromium-only synthetic push SW test. Full 3x6 matrix: CI.
- Screenshots test-results/screens/16 (iPad portrait/landscape, phone) reviewed against Planner/PhonePlan boards.

CHECKLIST: copy keys (planner.*, settings.plan.*, push.* in app_config + REQUIRED keys + defaults, noHardcodedCopy root added) OK; one lime per view (asserted in e2e; rebalance card violet, behind = amber + word + icon) OK; phone 390 no overlap OK; no dead UI (student-items UI intentionally absent; endpoint for S15/tutor); security: no answers touched, RLS + coverage + live_check updated, single head, no inline styles, VAPID secret handling OK; free-only, zero LLM calls OK; tests as above; sandbox hygiene (own -seg16 containers/ports).

DECISIONS / NOTES
- POST /api/plan/rebalance forwards the caller's token to the Aegra runtime on the server's own port. Accept/Decline always go through the interrupt (resume on the live thread, or a new run for coach proposals, which re-checks the fingerprint before answering).
- Removed duplicated ui_copy count caps in schemas.py after merges (bound is S19's 4000).
- Hosted DB, Space and real VAPID keys untouched. Public-Space steps for the owner: set VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY/VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY/VAPID_SUBJECT (SECRETS.md), make the Space public or use a custom domain, then docs/DEVICE_CHECKLIST.md "Web Push" / "Calendar feed" items.
- Known unrelated: tests/auth test_tokens_and_emails_never_logged is order-dependent in full local runs (passes alone and in the gate).
